title: Your First Weekend at Cedarville University, Shared as Cards
description: Navigate your first 1,000 days starting with Getting Started Weekend, from the high-energy move-in to the traditional Jacket Jaunt around Cedar Lake.

cards.title: The Grand Entrance
cards.subtitle: Friday Morning Arrival
cards.notes: Drive down University Boulevard to meet Sting leaders waving pool noodles and signs to welcome you home.
cards.short_summary: The high-energy official welcome for new students arriving on campus for move-in.
cards.evidence_claim: New students are greeted by student volunteers (Sting leaders) with pool noodles and signs as they drive onto campus.
cards.source_title: Getting Started Weekend - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Open to all incoming students and families during designated move-in hours.

cards.title: Meet Your Sting Group
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Connection
cards.notes: Gather with your assigned group of 10-12 new students and upperclassman leaders to start building community.
cards.short_summary: Small group orientation sessions led by current students to help freshmen transition.
cards.evidence_claim: Sting Groups consist of 10-12 new students led by 2-3 current students to prepare for campus life.
cards.source_title: Getting Started Weekend | August 14-16, 2026 - Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Required for all new undergraduate students; groups meet at various campus locations.

cards.title: Jacket Fest Party
cards.subtitle: Friday Night Celebration
cards.notes: Head to this campus-wide party featuring music, laser tag, and cornhole to celebrate your first night.
cards.short_summary: A Friday night kickoff event for new students with games and social activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Jacket Fest is a party for new students featuring cornhole, music, laser tag, and more on Friday evening.
cards.source_title: What to Expect During Getting Started Weekend - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Held on Friday evening of Getting Started Weekend for all new students.

cards.title: Dinner at Chuck's
cards.subtitle: Saturday Meal Tradition
cards.notes: Visit the newly renovated dining hall, affectionately known as Chuck's, for a meal with your new hallmates.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall located on the upper level of the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Commons is the main dining hall, often called 'Chuck's' by students, located in the Stevens Student Center.
cards.source_title: All About the Dining Hall! - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Open for brunch 11:00 AM - 1:00 PM and dinner 4:30 PM - 6:30 PM on Saturdays.

cards.title: The Jacket Jaunt
cards.subtitle: Saturday Evening Tradition
cards.notes: Walk around Cedar Lake with your class as faculty and staff cheer you on to officially join the family.
cards.short_summary: A signature tradition where the freshman class circles the campus lake together.
cards.evidence_claim: The Jacket Jaunt involves the freshman class circling Cedar Lake while being cheered on by faculty and staff.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions and Events | Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Takes place Saturday evening of Getting Started Weekend.

cards.title: Coffee at Rinnova
cards.subtitle: Late Saturday Afternoon
cards.notes: Grab a latte at the student-run coffee shop in the lower SSC before the evening activities begin.
cards.short_summary: Cedarville's full-service campus coffee shop located in the Stevens Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: Rinnova is located inside the lower entrance of the Stevens Student Center and offers coffee, tea, and smoothies.
cards.source_title: Housing and Dining on Campus - Cedarville University
cards.access_notes: Open Saturdays from 10:30 AM to 4:00 PM.

cards.title: Hike the Reserve
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Outing
cards.notes: Take a 25-minute walk from campus to explore scenic trails and waterfalls with your new friends.
cards.short_summary: A nearby nature reserve popular with students for hiking and outdoor relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: Indian Mound Reserve is a 25-minute walk from campus and offers scenic trails and waterfall views.
cards.source_title: Navigating Your First Week at Cedarville: Tips from a Super Senior - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Public park accessible during daylight hours; walking distance from campus.

cards.title: Fall Bible Conference
cards.subtitle: Monday Morning Session
cards.notes: Join the entire student body in the Dixon Ministry Center for the first session of this annual spiritual kickoff.
cards.short_summary: A multi-day conference that begins the academic year with worship and teaching.
cards.evidence_claim: Fall Bible Conference begins on the Monday following Getting Started Weekend with sessions at 10 a.m. and 7 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Held in the Jeremiah Chapel; open to all students.

cards.title: Stinger's Birthday Bash
cards.subtitle: Monday Night Social
cards.notes: Celebrate the school mascot with ice cream and live music on the patio overlooking the lake.
cards.short_summary: A social event featuring ice cream and music to celebrate the university's mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: The evening session of Fall Bible Conference is followed by a birthday party for Stinger with ice cream and live music on the SSC Lakeside Patio.
cards.source_title: Navigating Your First Week at Cedarville: Tips from a Super Senior - Student Life
cards.access_notes: Takes place Monday evening following the chapel session.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Monday Afternoon Prep
cards.notes: Scout out a cubicle or a group study room to prepare for the first day of classes on Tuesday.
cards.short_summary: The main campus library offering various quiet and group study environments.
cards.evidence_claim: Centennial Library features cubicle desks and group study rooms for student use.
cards.source_title: Where to Study on Campus - Student Life - Cedarville University Blogs
cards.access_notes: Standard academic hours apply; check for holiday or special event closures.
